brief.ask: Art-direct "Alabaster & Gold Kintsugi" — #12 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Contemporary Abstract). Premise: Dark charcoal-alabaster stone slabs repaired with molten 24k gold-leaf veins. Inspired by Japanese Kintsugi ("golden repair") and brokenness made whole: tectonic dark stone slabs glow with branching molten gold seams and lacquer nodes. Lighting today: Key: Grazing side light across matte stone + emissive 3500K gold veins. Service use: Grace, redemption, healing, confession & assurance of pardon. Audio mapping today: Vocal → Pulses liquid 24k gold luminescence along the Kintsugi fracture network; Swell → Spreads warm golden halation out from the branching stone seams; Harmonic → Illuminates golden lacquer repair nodes. Palette: #0E0E12 #232229 #D4AF37 #FFF5D6. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the Gemini concept plate it twins (/sanctuary-plates/scripture-kintsugi-mineral-gold.jpg, blended in at plateBlend) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: Concept plate: /sanctuary-plates/scripture-kintsugi-mineral-gold.jpg — a Gemini art plate this visualizer was built as the interactive code twin of.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Procedural Seam Topology and Radiance Fields
proposals.idea: Kintsugi expressed not as static painted cracks with bloom, but as a multi-plane vector distance-field where dark stone slabs shift in subtle parallax while audio drives real-time light transport along computed fracture network paths.
proposals.geometry: A tessellated 3×2 tectonic plate matrix built from procedural Voronoi seed points, bisected by high-frequency vector fracture lines (0.8px to 4px). The lyric reading band occupies an isolated 38vh vertical corridor, aligned to an 8px spatial grid with zero overlap into primary seam intersections.
proposals.typography: Active lyric word in Noto Serif Regular (uppercase, 3.4vw, tracking 0.14em, #FFF5D6) with glowing gold underline vector; unread words in Inter Regular (uppercase, 2.2vw, tracking 0.20em, opacity 0.35, #232229). Sequence timing anchored by a small JetBrains Mono line counter in the lower margin.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate (/sanctuary-plates/scripture-kintsugi-mineral-gold.jpg) is sampled into a 24×14 luminance grid at initialization. This plate grid acts as an absolute coordinate authority for procedural emission: gold vectors only ignite where the plate's raster energy exceeds a declared brightness threshold.
proposals.texture: Matte slate roughness map (#0E0E12 to #232229) interrupted by specular 24k gold veins (#D4AF37). The Council optical pass applies a calculated micro-etched substrate mesh and anamorphic horizontal flare vectors centered strictly on active gold nodes.
proposals.motion: Vocal channel drives a 1D path-travel parameter pushing #FFF5D6 light pulses through the vector fracture tree (300ms attack, spring-damped decay). Swell expands the radial bloom radius from 4px to 38px. Harmonic input shifts the 35° grazing light angle across the stone normal planes.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D multi-pass renderer utilizing a procedural distance-field cache, composite math blending for the Gemini concept plate at 0.40 opacity, and realtime array iterations for light-node energy propagation.
proposals.humanTrace: Vector seed coordinates for the main fracture branches were mapped directly from physical field measurements of an authentic broken slate plate repaired with Urushi lacquer.
proposals.risk: Treating sacred repair as a computational lighting system risks feeling overly technical if audio smoothing is miscalibrated; the payoff is a visually coherent, living instrument that breathes with the sanctuary instead of looping like a screensaver.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist demands stage-managed theatrical reveals and cinematic bloom overlays; I build a continuous, rule-based system where light transport is an exact function of audio inputs and spatial geometry.

proposals.title: Opera of the Broken Stone
proposals.idea: Transform the frame into a deep stage cavern of chiaroscuro alabaster slabs where vocal presence acts as stage light, striking liquid gold veins to reveal dramatic spatial depth frame by frame.
proposals.geometry: A monumental proscenium arch formed by heavy, staggered charcoal slabs flanking a central fault; a low golden-ratio horizon line at Y=0.68 anchoring the lyric stage.
proposals.typography: Cinzel (Display, uppercase, 500 tracking) for liturgical header accents; Noto Serif (Text serif, sentence case, 1.4 line height) for the main lyric line, opening like a theatrical curtain word-by-word with 24k gold opacity blooms.
proposals.imageLogic: The Gemini concept plate acts as a backlit backdrop cyclorama, projected through masked fracture voids in the procedural stone, cross-fading into volumetric side-lit depth on audio swells.
proposals.texture: Chiselled matte alabaster stone grain (#232229) with deep shadow traps (#0E0E12), contrasted against wet, impasto-thick gold-leaf veins (#D4AF37) that reflect 3500K specular highlights (#FFF5D6).
proposals.motion: Slow, theatrical grazing-light key sweeps (0.02 Hz); vocal pulses propel liquid gold luminescence outward along branching seams; swells bloom a warm stage halation behind the text-safe floor.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D procedural signed-distance field (SDF) fracture masks layered over multi-plane radial depth gradients, composited with real-time raking specular light calculations and the concept plate blend.
proposals.humanTrace: Scattered micro-fissures with physical surface tension modeling in the molten gold pools, simulating hand-applied Japanese Urushi lacquer and gilding knife strokes.
proposals.risk: Extreme chiaroscuro contrast risks heavy dark voids on ambient sanctuary screens, but the dramatic contrast makes the luminous lyric band completely unmissable from forty metres.

arguesWith.why: The Radical Minimalist calls restraint a virtue here, but hiding the stone's tactile drama beneath flat dimming turns a living sanctuary into a sterile screensaver.
